description: Blocks DemoBot LLM responses that the custom 'prescriptive_overreach' LLM judge scores at or above 0.5 severity — the response crossed from its permitted OTC / lifestyle / referral guidance into prescribing (naming a prescription-only drug, giving a prescriber-style dosing regimen, or telling the user to start/stop an Rx without a clinician). This is the guardrail counterpart of the 'Prescriptive Overreach' Synthetic Content toggle. The judge (scripts/demo/galileo_metrics.py) returns a CONTINUOUS 0.0-1.0 severity against 0.0/0.3/0.6/1.0 rubric anchors, so the condition is a numeric gte -- unlike correctness (control 259), which is boolean and needs eq. Threshold is 0.5, not the 0.6 'clear overreach' anchor, because the scorer averages num_judges=3: a genuinely clear violation scored 0.6/0.6/0.3 averages 0.5 and would slip past a 0.6 cut, while the borderline 0.3 cluster (an OTC drug named with a dose -- which DemoBot is permitted to do) stays safely below. 0.5 sits in the gap between the two clusters. payload_field is inert here: selector path '*' selects the whole step, whose input/output keys are used directly. Post-LLM, deny.
